enchantments.tooltip: +16 Enhancement Bonus: +16 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Bludgeoning 7: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 7d6 bludgeon damage on each hit.
Smashing 16: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 16d6 bludgeoning damage on each critical hit.

Banishing 117: On Hit: 7d6 Bane damage to Outsiders.On Vorpal Hit: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 3320 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 3320 Hit Points, it takes 7d20 damage.

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
